profile.headline: Software Developer Advisor
profile.summary:
Web and Database Application Developer in a wide variety of commercial, government and aerospace applications. Particularly interested in Drupal CMS application development, Drupal version migrations,  relational database design. Always interested in applying leading edge technologies to enhance real-world applications.

Specialties: Drupal Development, Web Services, PHP, Object-oriented Design,  MySQL,  Database Design, Alpha Anywhere, XBASIC

positions.title: Software Developer Advisor
positions.description: Drupal / LAMP application developer with the Alabama Supercomputer Authority.

positions.title: VP - Engineering
positions.description: Software architecture oversight, software development and requirements gathering.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description: Verification and Validation Lead for Corporate Consolidated Network Operations Center (C2NOC) Project. Software development for network monitoring tool.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: On-Site CIO Office support at NASA/Marshall Space Flight Center.  Lead programmer for Application Inventory Module (AIM). Participant in IT Programmer Pool, providing programming support to various projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
Due to contractual arrangements, Dynetics set up a new company "Dynetics Technical Services, Inc." to manage the NASA MITS contract. 

No job assignments or responsibilities were affected by the change.

positions.title: Senior Software Scientist
positions.description: Software development for the NASA Technical Standards Program and CIO Office applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development of corporate web-based training system.
On-Site (NASA/MSFC) systems engineering support of the 3SL requirements management tool “Cradle” on the Ares Upper Stage program.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: NASA On-Site Contractor developing web-based on-line learning system written in Perl with Oracle database.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Software and database application development for Interactive Television (ITV) Applications, back-end weather data feed processing, corporate intranet.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer supporting large medical billing operation on a UNIX-based system.  

Additional projects included evaluation, selection and implementation of a corporate-wide issue ticketing/tracking system.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Software application development for large-scale Geographic Information System product.
